trip: 13-19 Oct 2026 · AX ODYCY Malta, Qawra · event at BLAST Arena Studios, Ta' Qali, Ħ'Attard

items.name: Bus 186 — Buġibba/Qawra ↔ Ta' Qali (event-day route)
items.address: Buġibba bus station bay 6 (hotel side: Qawra seafront stops) → Ta' Qali Villagg / Ta' Qali Stadium
items.hours: Mon–Fri every 30 min 05:30–18:30, hourly to 22:30; Sat & Sun hourly 05:30–22:30 (Nov 2025 timetable; check tallinja app for the trip week)
items.price_range: €2.00–2.50 single (2h) or covered by 7-day Explore card
items.description: The only direct bus linking the Qawra/Buġibba hotel area with Ta' Qali, where BLAST Arena Studios (MFCC) sits. Journey Qawra seafront → Ta' Qali Villagg ≈ 32 min; alight at Ta' Qali Villagg (craft village) or Ta' Qali Stadium and walk to MFCC.
items.notes: Route existence confirmed on the operator's 2026 route list (publictransport.com.mt/routes-timetables-view-all-routes/); detailed timings from the unofficial maltabybus.com atlas (Nov 2025 edition, updated 1 Nov 2025). Re-check exact times in the tallinja app before travelling. Operator journey planner is the authority.

items.name: Bus TD1 (Tallinja Direct) — Airport ↔ Rabat ↔ Qawra/Buġibba ↔ Mellieħa ↔ Ċirkewwa
items.address: Airport stand 1 → QAWRA Arznel stop / Buġibba bay 8
items.description: Fastest one-seat bus from the airport to the hotel area (≈49 min to Buġibba). Limited-stop service that replaced route X1 in April 2025. Stops at Qawra (Arznel, inland side of Qawra) and Buġibba terminus — a short walk/taxi to AX ODYCY on Qawra Coast Road.
items.notes: Route exists on the operator's 2026 route list; fare €3.50 for TD1 per the official fares page. Timings from the Nov 2025 atlas. With luggage after a transatlantic flight, a fixed-fare airport taxi is the usual choice.

items.name: Bus TD5 (Tallinja Direct) — Airport ↔ Rabat ↔ Qawra/Buġibba (daytime extra)
items.address: Airport stand 1 → QAWRA Arznel / Buġibba bay 8
items.hours: Mon–Fri 08:30–13:30 departures (6); Sat & Sun 08:30–12:30 (5) — Nov 2025 atlas
items.description: Daytime supplement to TD1 between the airport and Qawra/Buġibba via Rabat; introduced 27 July 2025. Useful if arriving mid-morning; otherwise TD1 covers the day.
items.notes: TD fare €3.00 per official fares page (TD1 is €3.50).

items.name: Bus 214 — Buġibba/Qawra ↔ Rabat ↔ Balzan/B'Kara ↔ Marsa ↔ Paola ↔ Airport (local)
items.hours: All-day local service (operator route list 2026; see tallinja for times)
items.description: The slow local bus that replaced historic X3 on the airport corridor; also the only other route touching the 'Qali' area (Qali 2 stop, south of Ta' Qali — not the MFCC). Scenic-but-slow alternative to TD1.
items.notes: Route listed by the operator in 2026. Atlas note: 'a faster Airport–Bugibba service than route 214 (previously X3)'.

items.name: Bus 45 — Qawra ↔ Valletta (via Mosta)
items.description: The main one-seat bus from Qawra into Valletta (≈50–60 min). The atlas Valletta index lists 45 as the Qawra route; 31/48 also link Buġibba with Valletta via Mosta.
items.notes: Atlas warns services can be standing-room-only by the time they reach mid-route stops; board at Buġibba terminus for a seat.

items.name: Bus 212 — Sliema ↔ St Julian's ↔ Coast Road ↔ Buġibba/Qawra (scenic)
items.address: Sliema Ferries ↔ Spinola ↔ Pembroke ↔ Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq ↔ St Paul's Bay ↔ Buġibba (returns via Qawra seafront)
items.hours: Sept 22–Oct 31 timetable applies on trip dates (atlas); frequent by day; N212 night service 23:50/00:20/00:50/01:20 from Qawra
items.description: The scenic coastal link from the hotel area to Sliema/St Julian's — the route for dinners out, ferry to Valletta, or the nightlife belt. Sit on the right northbound for sea views.
items.notes: The atlas publishes an explicit Sept 22–Oct 31 schedule; N212 'may only run Fri & Sat nights during certain winter months' — check before relying on it midweek.

items.name: Bus TD13 — Valletta ↔ San Ġiljan ↔ Pembroke ↔ Coast Road ↔ Buġibba (express)
items.address: Valletta bay A15 ↔ Buġibba bay 2, limited stops via coast road
items.hours: Mon–Fri 05:05–20:35 + Sat/Sun service (atlas); every 30 min off-peak, 15 min peaks
items.description: Limited-stop express between Valletta and Buġibba via the coast road (~45 min) — faster than 45/212 for the Valletta run, at a higher fare.
items.notes: TD routes are excluded from the 7-day Explore card (official card terms) — use single/contactless or the 12-journey card.

items.name: Bus single fares (official)
items.price_range: Day €2.50 summer / €2.00 winter · Night €3.00 · Special (S) €3.00 · TD €3.00 · TD1 €3.50
items.description: Official 2026 fare table. Singles are valid 2 hours with free transfers; pay cash or tap a contactless bank card/phone. €50 fine without a valid ticket. Drivers do not give change.
items.notes: Winter/summer switchover: the operator still shows the 2025/26 winter window (19 Oct 2025–13 Jun 2026); the 2026/27 window is unpublished as of 9 Oct 2026. Pattern suggests summer €2.50 applies 13–18 Oct with winter €2.00 from ~19 Oct — verify a week out. At worst a €0.50/ride difference.

items.name: Explore Adult 7-Day card
items.address: Buy: airport sales offices (Welcomer's Hall + Baggage Reclaim), Valletta terminal, Buġibba terminal, Sliema Ferries, card machines, Agenda/8TillLate/WH Smith
items.description: 7 days unlimited Day Routes + Night Routes + select Special Services; individual, non-shareable. For a 6-night stay this is the default money card if you ride daily.
items.notes: Coverage contradiction on the operator's own page: the card description says it 'excludes tallinja Direct Routes' while the summary blurb says 'this card also includes the Airport Direct service'. Flagged 2-vs-1 on the operator's pages — ask at the sales desk whether TD1 is covered before relying on it.

items.name: 12 Single Day Journeys card
items.description: 12 journeys on Day Routes + Special Services, shareable within a group, valid 6 months from first use. Night Routes and Airport Direct cost 2 journeys per trip. The flexible alternative if some days are spent inside the venue/hotel.
items.notes: Good fit if the itinerary mixes lazy resort days with sightseeing — can top up as needed.

items.name: Explore Flex card (new 2026 product)
items.address: Sales offices and card machines; link to tallinja app
items.price_range: 4-day bus €21 · 7-day bus €27 · with Gozo Highspeed return €36/€42 · harbour cruise €36/€42 · 2-islands €53/€59 · hop-on-hop-off €41/€51
items.description: New flexible pass: 4 or 7 days unlimited bus (Day + Night + Airport Direct + Special), optionally bundled with Gozo ferry, harbour cruise or hop-on bus; can be topped up with credit in the tallinja app for Valletta ferry fares. 2 Airport Direct trips add-on €6.
items.notes: Unlike the classic Explore card, the Flex terms explicitly include Airport Direct. €2 more than Explore 7-day — worth it alone for the airport coverage clarification.

items.name: White taxi (airport fixed-fare counter)
items.address: Malta International Airport, Welcomer's Hall arrivals — pre-pay desk, 24/7
items.price_range: ≈€25–35 to Qawra/Buġibba (fixed zone fare; guide range 2026)
items.description: Government-licensed white taxis: fixed, pre-paid fares from the desk in arrivals (no meter surprises). The default door-to-door option with luggage after a long flight — 25–35 min to AX ODYCY outside peak traffic.
items.notes: 2026 guides disagree on the exact Qawra/Buġibba band: taxibambino €25–30; hubpymalta desk prices 'Bugibba/Qawra €35'; rozie.app €25–30; mappytravel counter photo €28 to Qawra. Budget €35, hope for €28. Exact fare is posted at the counter.

items.name: Rideshare — Bolt, eCabs, Uber
items.address: Airport pickups from P1 car park (not the taxi rank)
items.description: App-based rides with upfront pricing. Bolt and eCabs can be booked/reserved in advance; Uber exists in Malta but without advance booking. Best value for late returns from St Julian's/Paceville and for point-to-point trips taxis overcharge.
items.notes: Prices are dynamic (20–30% spread between apps); download Bolt + eCabs before flying and check both. Availability thins in rural west/south and on Gozo.

items.name: Taxi/rideshare AX ODYCY ↔ BLAST Arena Studios (event days)
items.address: Qawra Coast Road → Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre, Ta' Qali
items.description: By road Qawra→Ta' Qali is ~10–12 km via Mosta/Rabat road (15–25 min depending on traffic). For two or more people sharing, an app taxi beats the bus for reliability before a match start — budget €15–25 each way.
items.notes: Distance/time from map tools; no operator publishes a fixed Qawra–Ta' Qali fare. Treat the price band as an estimate — confirm in Bolt/eCabs on the day. UNVERIFIED estimate, not a quote.

items.name: Car rental
items.address: Airport and resort desks (Hertz, Avis, local agencies)
items.description: Full freedom for Gozo/south-coast touring; driving is on the LEFT, roads are narrow, and parking in Valletta/Sliema is paid and scarce. US licences are accepted for short stays (confirm with the agency). Not needed for the event week.
items.notes: Daily rates are third-party guide estimates, not quotes. Skip unless planning a packed Gozo+south road day.

items.name: Valletta Ferry Services — Sliema ↔ Valletta and Three Cities
items.hours: Every 30 min; summer timetable to 31 Oct (Sliema departures 06:45–01:00, Sun from 08:45)
items.price_range: Adult €3.00 single / €5.00 return by day (€3.50/€5.20 after 19:30)
items.description: The 10-minute Grand Harbour crossing — pair it with route 212 to Sliema for the nicest Valletta arrival. Barrakka Lift links the Valletta landing to Upper Barrakka.
items.notes: Suspended in swell — check their site on the morning of travel. Covered as a bundle option on the Explore Flex card.

items.name: Gozo Highspeed fast ferry — Valletta/Sliema/Buġibba ↔ Mġarr, Gozo
items.address: Buġibba terminal ↔ Mġarr (Gozo) — 30 min from Buġibba
items.hours: Daily; online sales close 20 min before sailing
items.price_range: Buġibba €6.50 one way (€5.50–6.50 with tallinja card options); Valletta €7.50; Sliema €8.50
items.description: The fast ferry from the hotel's own bay straight to Gozo in ~30 min — the easiest Gozo day trip from Qawra, avoiding the 1-hour bus to Ċirkewwa.
items.notes: Restricted timetable on 14 & 17 Oct (Middle Sea Race) and Mġarr terminal works run to 31 Oct — check their sailing calendar for the trip week.

items.name: Gozo Channel ferry — Ċirkewwa ↔ Mġarr
items.hours: Roughly every 45 min incl. night sailings; 25 min crossing
items.price_range: Foot passenger ≈ €4.65 return (pay/validate on Gozo side)
items.description: The traditional car/passenger ferry from the northern tip; foot passengers pay on the Gozo side. Reach Ċirkewwa by bus 41/42 or X300 from Valletta, or 221 from Buġibba.
items.notes: For a Gozo day from Qawra the Buġibba fast ferry is more convenient; Gozo Channel wins if taking a rental car.
